Plot variable importance from a random forest model

plot_rf_importance.Rd

Plot variable importance from a random forest model

Usage

plot_rf_importance(
  model,
  top_n = 20,
  fill = "#4E79A7",
  title = "Variable importance"
)

Arguments

model

A randomForest model or a data.frame with columns feature and importance.

top_n

Integer. Number of top features to display.

fill

Character. Bar fill color.

title

Character. Plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.

Required inputs

Provide either a randomForest model or a data.frame with columns feature and importance.
